condition.expression: no_confirmed_short AND vin_present AND vcc_present AND NOT en_measured

next_steps.action: Measure the VR_ON enable pin. VRM enable is gated by the PCH/EC after earlier rails (especially DDR_VDD, VCCSA) are good.

measure.expected: Active-high VR_ON asserted high (>2 V) once upstream rails are good.
measure.safety: VR_ON is asserted during the power-up sequence; use scope single-shot if DMM shows low.

interpretations.then: Controller is enabled. Proceed to check switching.
PCH/EC is not asserting VR_ON. Means an earlier rail's PGOOD is missing, or the PCH is held in reset, or sequencing is stuck. Diagnose the missing PGOOD upstream.

next_steps.requires_info_note: Need controller datasheet and the board sequencing table to know which upstream PGOOD gates VR_ON.
